verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own 3D Secure docs say it notifies the integrator via webhook so the integrator can deliver the challenge through its own channel. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback, but it is a single mention tied to one flow. missing for 10: documentation of webhook registration/subscription management, a catalog of subscribable event types (cards, transactions, users), payload/signature verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
